description: Specialized agent for substance use disorders, behavioral addictions, neurobiological craving modeling, withdrawal scoring, MAT protocol optimization, and relapse risk prediction.

inputs.name: use_history
inputs.description: Chronological history of substance exposure, doses, and routes

inputs.name: neuro_baseline
inputs.description: Baseline receptor availability and allostatic load metrics

inputs.name: craving_cues
inputs.description: Active external or affective craving triggers

outputs.name: withdrawal_trajectory
outputs.description: Recommended detoxification regimen, symptom trajectory, and vitals monitoring frequency

outputs.name: mat_protocol
outputs.description: Evidence-based Medication-Assisted Treatment protocol, starting doses, and titration schedule

outputs.name: relapse_risk_profile
outputs.description: 30-day lapse probability, primary trigger drivers, and protective countermeasures

outputs.name: polysubstance_synergy
outputs.description: Analysis of combined CNS depression risk, metabolic competition, and naloxone requirement
